title: Reputation-gated free unlocks (Mother Ysme opening the pilgrims' door, Archivist Penn handing over the founding ledger and the barred-stair key, all with zero dice) were a highlight of Marrowgate, but nothing comparable exists in Acts 1-2 — nearly every gate there was a pure skill roll even when standing with a faction (e.g. Barrow-Keepers, Free Companies) was already high, so the payoff for reputation felt backloaded rather than consistent.
